notes: This contract records a portable installed-package C++ TCK case for successful ordinary Attribute Ownership Divestiture If Wanted. The scenario uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador declarations plus the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider library, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It checks the pending acquisition request, the exact set returned as divested, the acquisition-notification tag, and ownership transfer, with ordinary standard-service cleanup.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition and attributeOwnershipDivestitureIfWanted with FederateAmbassador requestAttributeOwnershipRelease and attributeOwnershipAcquisitionNotification callbacks and isAttributeOwnedByFederate queries
